scripts.build:check: node scripts/prepare-build-check.mjs && node scripts/build-check.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-contracts-runtime.mjs && vitest run --exclude scripts/**/*.spec.mjs && node --test scripts/**/*.spec.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
